tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: Eviden Orange, from the ALIAS brand board (#FF6B00). Primary-action fills, the active nav marker, the logo. Never a status, never body text on light grounds (2.86:1 on white).

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Bleu foncé from the brand board (#0B2D4A). App icon ground, text on orange fills (4.94:1), ink of the light theme.

tokens.name: brand-grey-light
tokens.usage: Gris clair from the brand board (#F3F4F6). Light theme page ground.

tokens.name: brand-grey-neutral
tokens.usage: Gris neutre from the brand board (#E6E8EB). Light theme separators and hover rows.

tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Page ground behind panels and the map frame.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, sidebar, the site header: the surface most text sits on.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Raised or inset areas inside a panel: table header row, input fields, selected tab.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed rows. Never the only sign of selection (pair with accent-marker).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline separators between rows and panels. Decorative only (below 3:1).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, secondary buttons, the unknown-state dashed outline. 3:1 on bg-100 in both themes.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and key values. 14:1 on bg-100 in both themes.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: column headers, metadata, timestamps. ≥5.9:1 on bg-100.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary hints, placeholders, disabled labels. ≥4.5:1 on bg-100 and bg-000; not for anything the operator must read to act.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Interaction colour: primary button fill, active nav marker, selection bar, progress fill. Interaction only: never a state.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange when it must be read as text or thin line: links, the active nav label, focus ring. 7.3:1 dark, 5.2:1 light on bg-100.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (4.94:1). White on orange is 2.86:1: not used.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected nav row and selected table row ground; carries accent-text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline, offset 2px. Orange-derived so it never reads as a state.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Sain / en service / relié: a service measured healthy. Only for something actually measured: no default green.

tokens.name: status-ok-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of an ok badge (status-ok text on it ≥4.7:1).

tokens.name: status-degraded
tokens.usage: Dégradé: running but short of nominal (an instance down, capacity low, quota near). Yellow, lighter than accent in dark and darker in light so it is told apart from orange by lightness.

tokens.name: status-degraded-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of a degraded badge.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: En erreur / arrêté sur incident / révoqué / bloqué: needs action. Crimson leaning pink to keep clear of the orange; always with its glyph and label.

tokens.name: status-error-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of an error badge and of an alert row.

tokens.name: status-pending
tokens.usage: En attente / en cours / en rapatriement: the desired state is set and the real state is converging. Blue is free here because interaction is orange.

tokens.name: status-pending-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of a pending badge and progress track.

tokens.name: status-unknown
tokens.usage: Inconnu: no data (supervision down, never measured). Always drawn hollow with a dashed line-strong outline and a “?” glyph, never filled, never green.

tokens.name: map-feature
tokens.usage: geoMap: default colour of a mission feature (web/src/map/missionLayer.ts DEFAULT_COLOR). Map canvas only.

tokens.name: map-guide
tokens.usage: geoMap: dashed construction lines and neutral symbol points (missionLayer.ts, symbolLayer.ts). Map canvas only.

tokens.name: map-empty
tokens.usage: geoMap: map background when no vector basemap is loaded (web/src/map/style.ts).

tokens.name: map-halo
tokens.usage: geoMap: label halos and point strokes on the map (missionLayer.ts). Map canvas only.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Key figures on the overview (services up, nodes, queue fill). Tabular figures.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: La liaison s'est refermée, la reprise se fera au point d'arrêt.

styles.name: body-dense
styles.usage: Table cells, service rows, catalogue rows: the density default.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Row names, the first column of a table.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Dernier échange réussi il y a 3 j 4 h

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Column headers and field group labels, set in capitals.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Coordinates (MGRS, lat/lon), versions, hashes, log lines.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row padding (vertical), gaps inside a control group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Cell padding (horizontal), panel padding in dense views.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Separation between page sections; the most air this product takes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs, table-row selection.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, panels, map floating panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the login card, the app icon at small sizes.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Link indicator and counters only.

tokens.name: row-dense
tokens.usage: Service, catalogue and log rows on desktop: 20 rows fit a 1280×800 screen.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Rows on tablet and form controls.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area on tablet, even when the row is drawn denser.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Site header.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-collapsed
tokens.usage: Icon-only sidebar.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Floating panels over the map, menus. Panels on the page use line, not shadow.

meta.note: Brand from the ALIAS brand board image and the 'Brief de conception — console ALIAS' doc supplied by Younes; UI scale designed for the operator console.
